summary: Indian stocks look set for a gap-up open after the holiday, as cheaper oil and steady foreign buying outweigh a hotter US inflation print that dragged Wall Street lower.

detail.leaders: Oil-sensitive names such as OMCs, paints, tyres and airlines; IIFL Finance on its Blackstone-led raise
detail.laggards: MRF and Cochin Shipyard after weak quarterly profits; US-linked tech on rate-hike worries
detail.tone: A forward-looking pre-open read. GIFT Nifty points to a firmer start than the overnight Wall Street dip alone would suggest, with lower crude and foreign inflows doing the lifting.
